title: A class of d-dimensional directed polymers in a Gaussian environment
summary: We introduce and analyze a broad class of continuous directed polymers in $\mathbb{R}^d$ driven by Gaussian environments that are white in time and spatially correlated, under Dalang's condition. Using an Itô-renormalized stochastic-heat-equation representation, we establish structural properties of the partition function, including positivity, stationarity, scaling, homogeneity, and a Chapman--Kolmogorov relation.
